mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a comfortable 66 degrees with clear skies near Verona Area High School and the moon is in its first quarter phase.

Verona is prioritizing infrastructure and environmental safety. The city has launched an Adopt A Storm Drain program to protect our waterways from runoff, and construction continues on Mark Drive with phase two currently underway.
There is plenty to do in our community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding the police report, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I this past Thursday after reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
Stop by for today's flavor, Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
